description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'updateStatusCommand' that retrieves and displays the update status of a software, including formatting and rendering update information, handling JSON output, and generating a terminal table with update details.

classes.name: UpdateStatusOptions
classes.description: Type for options parameter of 'updateStatusCommand', includes 'timeout' and 'json' flags.

methods.name: formatGitStatusLine
methods.description: Formats a git status line based on branch, tag, and sha information.

methods.name: updateStatusCommand
methods.description: Main function to check and display the update status, either as JSON or formatted table.
